people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

translations.web: The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field.”
translations.bsb: Anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.”
translations.kjv: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
translations.asv: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the birds of the heavens eat.
